lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram maaiaa vichahu kateeai sachaRai naam samaae ||
lines.translation: Doubt and Maya have been removed from within me, and I am merged in the Naam, the True Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai naam samaae har gun gaae mil preetam sukh paae ||
lines.translation: Merged in the True Name of the Lord, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; meeting my Beloved, I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee vichahu ha(n)umai jaae ||
lines.translation: I am in constant bliss, day and night; egotism has been dispelled from within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee purakhee har naam chit laaiaa tin kai ha(n)u laagau paae ||
lines.translation: I fall at the feet of those who enshrine the Naam within their consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaa(n)iaa ka(n)chan taa(n) theeai jaa satigur lae milaae ||2||
lines.translation: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sachaa sach salaaheeai je satigur dei bujhaae ||
lines.translation: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਨਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur bharam bhulaaneeaa kiaa muhu desan aagai jaae ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt; going to the world hereafter, what face will they display?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਨਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਾਏ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa den muhu jaae avagun pachhutaae dukho dukh kamaae ||
lines.translation: What face will they show, when they go there? They will regret and repent for their sins; their actions will bring them only pain and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rateeaa se ra(n)g chaloolaa pir kai a(n)k samaae ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they merge into the Being of their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis jevad avar na soojhaee kis aagai kaheeai jaae ||
lines.translation: I can conceive of no other as great as the Lord; unto whom should I go and speak?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: so sachaa sach salaaheeai je satigur dei bujhaae ||3||
lines.translation: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sachaRaa sach salaahiaa ha(n)u tin laagau paae ||
lines.translation: I fall at the feet of those who praise the Truest of the True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan sache niramale tin miliaa mal sabh jaae ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings are true, and immaculately pure; meeting them, all filth is washed off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin miliaa mal sabh jaae sachai sar naae sachai sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: Meeting them, all filth is washed off; bathing in the Pool of Truth, one becomes truthful, with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nira(n)jan agam agochar satigur deeaa bujhaae ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has given me the realization of the Naam, the Immaculate Name of the Lord, the unfathomable, the imperceptible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi ra(n)g raate naanak sach samaae ||
lines.translation: Those who perform devotional worship to the Lord night and day, are imbued with His Love; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sachaRaa sach dhiaaiaa ha(n)u tin kai laagau paae ||4||4||
lines.translation: I fall at the feet of those who meditate on the Truest of the True. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਲਲਾਂ ਬਹਲੀਮਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s kee vaar mahalaa 4 lalaa(n) bahaleemaa kee dhun gaavanee ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Wadahans, Fourth Mehl: To Be Sung In The Tune Of Lalaa-Behleemaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵਡ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate vad ha(n)s hai sach naam ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: The great swans are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they enshrine the True Name within their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)grahahi sad sach rahahi sachai naam piaar ||
lines.translation: They gather Truth, remain always in Truth, and love the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa niramal mail na lagaee nadar keetee karataar ||
lines.translation: They are always pure and immaculate - filth does not touch them; they are blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hau tin kai balihaaranai jo anadin japahi muraar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who, night and day, meditate on the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai jaaniaa vad ha(n)s hai taa mai keeaa sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: I thought that he was a great swan, so I associated with him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: je jaanaa bag bapuRaa ta janam na dedee a(n)g ||2||
lines.translation: If I had known that he was only a wretched heron from birth, I would not have touched him. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾਂ ਭਿ ਆਯਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)saa vekh tara(n)diaa bagaa(n) bh aayaa chaau ||
lines.translation: Seeing the swans swimming, the herons became envious.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dub mue bag bapuRe sir tal upar paau ||3||
lines.translation: But the poor herons drowned and died, and floated with their heads down, and their feet above. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape hee aap aap hai aap kaaran keeaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are Yourself, all by Yourself; You Yourself created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape aap nira(n)kaar hai ko avar na beeaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are Yourself the Formless Lord; there is no other than You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai too karahi s theeaa ||
lines.translation: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes; what You do, comes to be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਸਭਨਾਹਾ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too anama(n)giaa daan devanaa sabhanaahaa jeeaa ||
lines.translation: You give gifts to all beings, without their asking.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aakhahu satigur vaahu vaahu jin daan har naam mukh deeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Everyone proclaims, "Waaho! Waaho!" Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has given the supreme gift of the Name of the Lord. ||1||
